event_chain.summary: Web application flaw exploited; guest reservation data taken

summary: On April 22, 2026 BWH Hotels, parent of Best Western Hotels & Resorts, WorldHotels and SureStay, detected that attackers had exploited a flaw in a web application holding guest reservation data. Guest names, email addresses, phone numbers, home addresses and reservation details such as reservation numbers, dates of stay and special requests from reservations made between October 14, 2025 and April 22, 2026 were accessed; payment information was not stored in the system. BWH took the application offline, revoked the access and notified an undisclosed number of guests in May.
